summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; tests were not run, per instructions, so results are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative depth-first walk with an explicit stack and level counter. Each label is measured at max_width, plus 4 cells per level. Imports Measurement from .measure.
- rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__; Align.__rich_console__ now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width). Added VerticalCenter(JupyterMixin) with __init__, __repr__, __rich_console__ (newline-only vertical padding using console.size.height, negative counts skipped), and __rich_measure__ (delegates to Measurement.get).
- rich/console.py: print sets justify="default" in render options; the justify argument is still passed to _collect_renderables.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked "Unreleased", with an Added subsection listing the tree measurement and VerticalCenter; the existing markdown entry is kept.
- tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; added test_align_repr, test_vertical_center, test_vertical_center_measure, test_vertical_center_tall_content.
- tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement; added test_measure_tree (expects Measurement(11, 19)).

Notes: Align now shrinks auto-width renderables, so some existing Align output may change; the spec requires this, but the test suite has not been run to confirm. No commits were made.
